chunks: Youths of never-ending bloom will pass round to them
ai.seo_question: Who are the eternal youths serving in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'mukhalladun' (eternal) emphasizes the permanence of these youthful attendants, distinguishing them from the transient nature of worldly life and reflecting the divine attribute of eternal youth. This imagery serves as a tangible sign of the continuous, unaging bliss of the righteous, reinforcing the concept of Jannah as a realm of perpetual renewal and satisfaction.
